weapons.why: Fires a short cone of frost that inflicts Frostburn.

weapons.name: Inferno Fork
weapons.source: Dropped by Diabolists (Hardmode Dungeon)
weapons.why: Fires a fireball that explodes into a lingering damaging blast.

weapons.name: Killing Deck
weapons.source: Bought from the Wizard during a Blood Moon (Hardmode)
weapons.why: Launches serpentine card projectiles that deal bonus damage when they return.

weapons.name: Life Drain
weapons.source: Dropped by Crimson Mimics
weapons.why: Channels a homing beam that heals the player as it damages enemies.

weapons.name: Magic Dagger
weapons.source: Dropped by Mimics (Hardmode)
weapons.why: Throws a returning magic dagger toward the cursor.

weapons.name: Medusa Head
weapons.source: Dropped by Medusas (Marble Caves, Hardmode only)
weapons.why: Fires a horizontal stone beam that petrifies enemies it hits.

weapons.name: Poison Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Black Recluses (Spider caves, Hardmode)
weapons.why: Fires a poison fang projectile that pierces and inflicts Poisoned.

weapons.name: Razorblade Typhoon
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron
weapons.why: Fires high-velocity homing typhoons that pierce enemies and bounce off blocks.

weapons.name: Shadowbeam Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Necromancers (Hardmode Dungeon)
weapons.why: Fires a fast beam that ricochets off walls and pierces enemies.

weapons.name: Shadowflame Hex Doll
weapons.source: Dropped by Goblin Warlocks (Hardmode Goblin Army)
weapons.why: Fires homing shadowflame bolts that inflict the Shadowflame debuff.

weapons.name: Spectre Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Ragged Casters (Hardmode Dungeon)
weapons.why: Fires a homing spectral bolt that seeks enemies.

weapons.name: Unholy Trident
weapons.source: Dropped by Red Devils (Underworld, Hardmode)
weapons.why: Fires a spectral trident that passes through blocks.

weapons.name: Aqua Scepter
weapons.source: Found in Gold Chests / Golden Lock Boxes
weapons.why: Sprays a stream of water droplets that pierce enemies.

weapons.name: Gray Zapinator
weapons.source: Purchased from the Traveling Merchant (pre-Hardmode)
weapons.why: Fires an erratic light beam that ricochets and varies in size.

weapons.name: Demon Scythe
weapons.source: Dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons in the Underworld
weapons.why: Fires accelerating sickle projectiles that pierce up to five enemies.

weapons.name: Crimson Rod
weapons.source: Destroyed from Crimson Hearts, or fished in Crimson/Hematic Crates
weapons.why: Places a lingering blood cloud that rains piercing droplets downward onto enemies below.

armor.name: Adamantite Armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.headpieceBonus: +20% magic damage · +19% magic critical strike chance · +80 maximum mana · +19% mana cost reduction · +5% movement speed

armor.name: Titanium Armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.why: Attacking raises a barrier of titanium shards that absorbs damage.
armor.headpieceBonus: +23% magic damage · +13% magic critical strike chance · +100 maximum mana · +6% movement speed

armor.name: Forbidden Armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.why: Double-tap the set bonus key to call a storm at the cursor. Boosts both magic and summon damage.
armor.effect: +25% magic and summon damage · +80 maximum mana · +2 minion slots · A Forbidden Sign minion floats behind you; double-tap Down (or Up) to spend 20 mana and call an Ancient Storm at the cursor that rapidly deals 20 contact damage.

accessories.name: Sorcerer Emblem
accessories.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Increases magic damage by 15%.

accessories.name: Celestial Cuffs
accessories.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: The mana-on-hit effect helps salvage otherwise doomed attempts when a boss pattern catches you.
accessories.effect: Increases pickup range for mana stars · Restores mana when damaged · Increases maximum mana by 20

accessories.name: Mana Cloak
accessories.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Auto mana potions plus a defensive star burst when you take a hit.

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eye of Cthulhu)
accessories.why: Grants a short dash that damages enemies (double-tap a direction).

accessories.name: Terraspark Boots
accessories.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
accessories.why: Super-fast running and flight, with lava, water, and honey walking plus ice mobility.

accessories.name: Fairy Wings
accessories.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).

buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table, or found in Shadow Chests and Pots in the Underworld.

buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.why: +20 maximum mana, +5% magic damage, +2% magic critical strike chance, and -2% mana usage.

items.why: Reduces all damage taken by 17%.

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Brain of Cthulhu)
items.why: 16.67% chance to dodge an attack when hit, which grants +10% crit and summon damage for 4s; taking damage also has a 60% chance to confuse nearby enemies.

items.name: Ankh Shield
items.why: Provides 4 defense, and offers immunity to a wide assortment of debuffs.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Doubles the length of the player's immunity frames (to 4/3 of a second), and summons falling stars when the player is hit.

items.name: Charm of Myths
items.why: Combines the effects of a Philosopher's Stone with a Band of Regeneration:

items.name: Flesh Knuckles
items.why: Provides 8 defense, and increases the player's aggro by 400.
items.notes: Players seeking to simply maximize their defense can stack the Flesh Knuckles with a Berserker's Glove, even if they don't use melee weapons or whips. When reforged to Warding, these two accessories alone will provide the player with 24 extra defense.

items.name: Frozen Turtle Shell
items.why: When the player is below 50% max HP, this accessory reduces all damage taken by 25%.

items.name: Obsidian Shield
items.why: Knockback immunity, fire block immunity and 2 defense.

items.name: Putrid Scent
items.why: Increases damage by 5% and critical strike chance by 5%, and decreases the player's aggro by 400.

items.name: Apprentice's Scarf
items.source: Dropped by Dark Mage (T1) and 1 other source
items.why: Increases the player's sentry slots by one and buffs overall summon damage by 10%. Can be useful in hybrid summoner setups, depending on how high the base damage of your summons is.

items.name: Stinger Necklace
items.why: Combines the effects of the Shark Tooth Necklace with the Honey Comb.

items.name: Volatile Gelatin
items.why: Periodically fires small gelatin projectiles. Primarily useful when the player is doing idle activites such as fishing, but can also help if the player finds themselves getting overwhelmed in fights.

items.name: Mana Cloak
items.why: Combines the effects of the Mana Flower and Star Cloak. Additionally, the stars produced by the Star Cloak will transform into special mana stars, which restore 50 mana to the player.

items.name: Magnet Flower
items.why: Reduces mana cost by 8% and enables the player to collect mana stars more easily.
items.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Increases pickup range for mana stars

items.name: Arcane Flower
items.why: 8% reduced mana cost, auto mana potions, and enemies are less likely to target you.

items.name: Mana Flower
items.why: Auto-potions reduce cognitive load and keep your strongest spells online more consistently.
items.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed
